entries.back_en: For someone like me, this changes everything! Croma technology is known throughout all of Terragaya, but it's impossible to use here — vimana minerals don't occur naturally in this world.
entries.note: 'isso muda tudo' altera o sentido de 'you don't know what that means'.

entries.back_en: In other words, that machine comes from another place.
entries.note: 'a different one' refere-se a outro mundo; 'outro lugar' perde essa nuance.

entries.back_en: Could you bring me a few little feet from that flying contraption? Twenty Vimana Cogs will do. You have no idea how much I want to analyze this luck of technology.
entries.note: 'pezinhos' (pés) em vez de 'peças'; 'sorte de tecnologia' traduz mal 'sort of'.

entries.back_en: But... I'd like to ask a mega favor from a mega friend who admires you a lot.
